prompt: With a test in two weeks, Dan re-reads and highlights his notes and feels confident, but scores poorly on practice questions. Which change is best supported by learning research?

options.text: Highlight in more colours so the notes feel clearer
Close the notes and practise retrieving answers from memory, then check what he got wrong
Re-read the notes faster to fit in more passes
Only study the night before, when it feels most urgent

explanation: Re-reading creates a feeling of familiarity that is often mistaken for knowledge. Retrieval practice — answering from memory and checking — exposes gaps and strengthens recall.
